reviews.title: Worst
reviews.body: I’ve used both Dr. Sheth’s older Mineral Sunscreen and the new 100% Mineral Sunscreen. I actually tried the new one because I liked its texture a little more, but after using both, I still prefer the older sunscreen. The 100% Mineral Sunscreen didn’t feel as comfortable or appealing to me overall, and compared to the older formula, I just didn’t enjoy using it as much. For me, the texture alone wasn’t enough to make me switch. Personally, I would go back to the older sunscreen rather than repurchase this one.
reviews.author: Asha

reviews.title: Invisible Fluid Mineral Sunscreen
